summary: Frontend-only E2E of 3 Home changes (HD wide card, TopNav Auto play/Speed up, expand-in-place trailer). Almost everything passes. One real bug: pressing Enter/OK on the expanded 'Back' button shrinks the trailer on keydown, then the keyup lands on the tile and opens the trailer actions overlay again. Escape and Backspace shrink cleanly.

ui_bugs.issue: Enter on [data-testid=trailer-hover-shrink] shrinks on keydown (ExpandedControls.onKeyDown -> onShrink -> shrink() focuses tile). The keyup of the same press then reaches the document capture listener onPressEnd with target=tile. shouldIntercept() is true (preview playing, actions closed), so setActions(true) runs and the actions overlay reopens with focus on 'Open Trailer'. Reproduced 2/2 times, including with separate keyboard.down/up. On a TV remote, OK on Back never returns the user to the bare tile. Pressing ArrowRight afterwards only closes the overlay, so it takes one extra press to move on.

integration_issues.issue: Not verifiable. In headless Chromium the YouTube iframe [data-testid=trailer-hover-iframe] mounts but never reaches 'playing' (waited 9s), so Enter goes through normal tile press and navigates to /title/movie/<id>. The review request allows this.

issues: The PreviewStreamCheck badge (e.g. 'CAM COPY - 1' / 'NO STREAMS YET') floats alone at the very top-left corner of the full-screen overlay at small size. Consider hiding it or repositioning it while expanded.
Subtitle/year text stays at clamp(9px,0.62vw,11px) when expanded and is tiny on a 1920 screen.
The 'ON NOW TV V2' logo overlaps the hero title, and the hero title is clipped under the floating nav.
The hero carousel dots overlap the 'More Info' button.

Autoplay aria-label toggles 'Auto play · ON' <-> 'Auto play · OFF'

Mobile 390x844: top-nav-more opens compact-nav-menu with autoplay (circle-play) + Speed up (rocket); clicking Speed up closes the menu and shows the toast

Wide card: src always metahub '/background/medium/'. A MutationObserver saw 8 wide src observations with zero '/poster/', '/small/' or 'w342' values. Each ArrowRight (evaluated right after the press) gives a fresh with the backdrop src, and the previous tile goes back to '/poster/small/'.
Hover preview card appears inside the focused tile; its src === the wide tile src
Preload: backdrops for tiles N+1..N+4 all show up in performance resource entries

Expand-in-place (mocked bridge): video is playing inside the tile; Enter opens actions with focus on trailer-hover-fullscreen; Enter again expands. Same video element (===), no trailer-modal, currentTime continues (3.09->3.71->4.96), box is 1920x800, host is a direct child of body, focus is on trailer-hover-shrink. Arrow keys are swallowed while expanded.
Escape and Backspace shrink: same element back inside the tile, still playing, focus back on the original tile, no host left on body
After shrinking, ArrowRight tears down and a new video starts on the next tile (~3s)
Shelf navigation: Left/Right/Down move correctly; no console errors from TrailerHoverPreview/PosterTile/Shelf/TopNav (only third-party addon CORS errors, plexio/kangaroostreams)
action_items: Fix the Enter-on-Back reopen: either shrink on keyup in ExpandedControls, or set a one-shot 'suppressNextPressEnd' flag in shrink() that onPressEnd consumes (ignore the next Enter keyup / mouseup on the tile)
Optional: hide or reposition the PreviewStreamCheck badge and enlarge the subtitle when expanded
critical_code_review_comments: TrailerHoverPreview.jsx is ~820 lines; consider splitting ExpandedControls/ActionOverlay/VideoPreview/YtPreview into separate files.

The same keydown/keyup race as the Back bug may affect any future control that moves focus back to the tile on Enter keydown. Consider keeping keyup-based activation consistent across the actions overlay and the expanded controls.

success_rate.frontend: 93% (13/14 checks; TrailerModal fallback not verifiable in headless)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Home poster shelves are lazy: press ArrowDown 3x from top-nav-home to reach the first poster row (New movies, shelf-row-com.linvo.cinemeta-movie-year). Mock bridge via add_init_script before goto. To verify the fix, expand, press Enter on Back, then assert trailer-hover-actions is absent and activeElement is the tile.
rca of the issue: ExpandedControls.onKeyDown handles Enter on keydown -> onShrink -> shrink() moves focus to tile. The keyup of the same keystroke then fires document-level capture onPressEnd (line ~205) with e.target=tile. shouldIntercept returns true because preview.playing && !actions && tile===p.tile, so setActions(true). Mitigation: shrink on keyup, or set a suppress ref in shrink() that onPressEnd checks and clears.
